name: daily-prep
description: A scheduled morning brief that gets you ready for your day. For each meeting on today's calendar it produces a prep card (what it's about, who's in it, what to walk in ready to say/bring/decide), surfaces what needs you today (replies owed, open action items, what you're waiting on), looks ahead at the week and month, and once a week checks whether your activity points at your goals. Role-adaptive. Requires M365; enriched by Slack, Airtable, and Otter/Granola.
